back of the bezel: the LED's 2 legs
PG-1 wiring, page 10 of 10: Level lights + 330 ohm resistors -> PCF8574 board
Each light's 2 legs go to 2 P pins (either way round: if a light shows red with signal, swap its 2 wires). Each P4-P7 also gets a 330 ohm to VCC,
soldered on the PCF board's UNDERSIDE; the 4 resistors' other ends are joined and go to a VCC pin.
Steps (the number is on the wire):
in light (under Input Gain): the LEFT leg (either way
round) -> PCF8574: 'P4' on the row of 8 (in light
(swap its 2 legs, or set kSwapLightColours, if the
in light (under Input Gain): the RIGHT leg (either way
round) -> PCF8574: 'P5' on the row of 8 (in light)
out light (under Output Gain): the LEFT leg (either way
round) -> PCF8574: 'P6' on the row of 8 (out light)
out light (under Output Gain): the RIGHT leg (either way
round) -> PCF8574: 'P7' on the row of 8 (out light)
